instructions: Mince the garlic clove and put it in a jar with 1 tsp of the oregano, the 1/4 tsp salt, a few grinds of pepper, 3 tbsp red wine vinegar and the 6 tbsp olive oil. Put the lid on and shake it until it's well mixed. Set it aside for 20 minutes while you cut the vegetables.
Cut each of the 3 tomatoes into 6 wedges, then cut each wedge into 3 or 4 chunks. If they're very watery, scoop out the seeds with a teaspoon.
Slice the 4 cucumbers into rounds about 1/4 inch thick.
Peel half the onion and slice it thinly into rings. Wrap the other half for another day.
Cut the green pepper in half, pull out the seeds and white ribs, and cut it into short strips.
Cut the block of feta into 1/2 inch cubes.
Put the tomatoes, cucumbers, onion, pepper, feta and 3/4 cup olives in a large bowl and sprinkle the last 1 tsp oregano over them.
Shake the dressing again, pour it over the salad and toss it gently so the feta stays in pieces. Taste a piece of tomato, and add a pinch more salt if it's flat.
Serve right away with the pita.
method_notes: All three use tomato, cucumber, red onion, green pepper, Kalamata olives and feta with olive oil and oregano, and no lettuce. RecipeTin Eats shakes a garlic, oregano and red wine vinegar dressing in a jar and lets it sit 20 minutes, then cubes the feta and tosses everything together. My Greek Dish and Super Golden Bakes dress the vegetables with oil, a little vinegar and salt and set the feta on top as a whole slab with oregano over it; Super Golden Bakes rests the salad 15 to 20 minutes so the tomatoes release their juice. This one follows RecipeTin Eats.
